Exactly as a --verify recovery builds its
regions, so a re-probe can never accept a

unclassified
on purpose: this pass
re-reads a stretch the primary scan's own
expectations already came up empty on, so the
one thing it must not do is apply them a
second time. Its value is the heavier model
over the same audio, seen whole.
No second opinion to ask, either - every
window here already decodes through the
upgrade model.

The prober stops at its last candidate rather
than at the gap's end, and a gap yielding no
candidates reports nothing - so the bar would
otherwise sit behind the pass by up to a whole
gap.
book the gap as passed on the bar

The hole is filled, so the doubt is spent -
and only then: a partly filled hole is still
a hole.

rather than
its length: a region dense in qualifying silences
